name: monitoring--prometheus-dns-hostnames
description: Prometheus scrape targets use DNS hostnames instead of Docker service names for cross-network resolution

implementation.change: Replace Docker service names (litellm, headroom, qdrant) with fully qualified DNS hostnames (litellm.local.koeff.com, headroom.local.koeff.com, qdrant.local.koeff.com)

checks: prometheus.yml contains targets: ["litellm.local.koeff.com:4000"] for litellm job
prometheus.yml contains targets: ["headroom.local.koeff.com:8787"] for headroom job
prometheus.yml contains targets: ["qdrant.local.koeff.com:6333"] for qdrant job
No Docker service names (litellm:, headroom:, qdrant:) remain in scrape_configs
Prometheus container can resolve DNS hostnames via host network or external DNS
